{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f"Number of completed orders from loyal customers (before QA removal): {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]
print(f"Number of completed orders from loyal customers (after QA removal): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
